resolvedDuringDevelopment: Initial browser checks caught parent-ref mount timing; measurement now starts after committed refs and schedules into an animation frame.
Geometry reads/updates are frame-coalesced; redundant unchanged observer deliveries preserve an in-progress transition.

openFollowups.scope: Existing More tabs menu positioning path emits a ResizeObserver loop warning in WebKit for touch and pointer overflow cases. Functional promotion, focus, resize, scrolling and indicator-alignment assertions pass before the unchanged zero-page-error assertion.
openFollowups.isolation: Browser diagnostic bypassed the entire compiled TabIndicator function with an early null return. The same warning remained with the indicator and its observers absent; the diagnostic does not claim an exact full-repository baseline checkout.
openFollowups.acceptance: Retain all zero-page-error and interaction assertions; fix the owned Menu/React Aria overlay positioning path without disabling native resize handling or filtering errors.

limitations: Not an all-green browser matrix: 31 passed and 2 isolated WebKit overflow-menu warning failures.
Targeted development evidence; broader historical acceptance gates remain separate.
